mentions.name: Technology Stack Trends
mentions.description: This tool tracks explicit mentions of ~181 languages, technologies, and vendors in job postings to surface technology stack trends. It was built because GitHub activity and developer surveys reflect what people use or enjoy rather than what employers are actually requesting.
mentions.problem: GitHub activity and developer surveys describe what people use or enjoy, but not necessarily what employers are requesting in job postings.
mentions.source_excerpt: It tracks explicit mentions of ~ 181 languages, technologies, vendors, etc as seen in job postings. The motivation was that GitHub activity and developer surveys describe what people use or enjoy, but not necessarily what employers are requesting.

evidence.value: It tracks explicit mentions of ~ 181 languages, technologies, vendors, etc as seen in job postings. The motivation was that GitHub activity and developer surveys describe what people use or enjoy, but not necessarily what employers are requesting.
